name: LCM Upscale (node only)
plain: An LCM-style loop that enlarges the latent on a schedule between steps, so sampling and upscaling happen together. Not in the sampler list; only reached through its node. It adds noise with a raw VE formula rather than the model's noise scaling.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
x_d=D; if i<len(upscales): resize of x_d by upscale_method to orig×upscales[i]; upscales=linspace(1,total_upscale,K)[1:], K default max(len(sigmas)//2+1,2).
If σ'>0: x'=x_d+σ'·ε, ε from torch.randn_like.

props.final_sigma0: σ'=0 no noise; returns the resized D.
props.flow_const: No CONST branch: the VE line x_d+σ'ε is used, unlike sample_lcm which calls noise_scaling, and noise_scale is ignored.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Defaults: scale_ratio 1.0 (no upscale), scale_steps −1 (auto), method list includes bislerp, nearest-exact, bilinear, area, bicubic.

label: from code
surprise: Does not use model_sampling.noise_scaling and uses global RNG, so on flow models the noise level is not on the flow line.
